telugu: వింతైన ప్రేమ ఇదేగా – యేసయ్య ప్రేమ నిజంగా
ఇలాగే జయించి, వరించే ఆ ప్రేమలోనే – నే సాగిపోనా
ఇంతగా చేరువై పిలిచెనే – అంతగా సొంతమై నిలిచెనే
english: Vinthaina prema ideyga – yesayya prema nijamgaa
ilaage jayinchi, varinche aa premalone – ne saagiponaa
inthagaa cheruvai pilichene – anthagaa sonthamai nilichene

telugu: You’re my Maker – You are my Life
You’re my Savior – You are my Strength
You’re my Father – You are my King
english: You’re my Maker – You are my Life
You’re my Savior – You are my Strength
You’re my Father – You are my King

telugu: You’re my Fortress – You are my Friend
You’re my Leader – You are my Light
You’re my Comfort – You are my Hope
english: You’re my Fortress – You are my Friend
You’re my Leader – You are my Light
You’re my Comfort – You are my Hope

telugu: ఇదిగో యేసుని చూడగ రావా – ఆయన చెంతకు రావేలా ?
వీడని ప్రేమను చేరగ నీవు – ప్రేమతో తాను వేచేగా
మారని ప్రేమ, తీయని ప్రేమ – యేసుని ప్రేమే చాలునుగా
english: Idhigo yesuni choodaga raavaa – aayana chenthaku raavelaa?
veedani premanu cheraga neevu – prematho thaanu vechegaa
maarani prema, theeyani prema – yesuni preme chaalunugaa
You’re my Wonder – You are my Joy
You’re my Refuge – You are my Rock
You’re my Treasure – You are my Trust
